message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background dominated by a large, white-and-blue-clad man standing on a gray stepladder. He is seen from behind, reaching up to adjust a framed caricature. The man wears a light blue or white button-down shirt, tan trousers, and black shoes. His skin is tan, and he has short dark hair.

On the wall are three gold-framed portraits containing caricatures of men in suits. The man on the ladder is touching the frame of the top-right portrait. To its left is another portrait of a white-haired man, and below them is a portrait of a man wearing a black songkok.

In the bottom left, a pole with a red-and-white flag is partially visible. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters across the upper background. Text at the bottom reads "DEWAN PERTIMBANGAN APALAH-APALAH" followed by a paragraph in Indonesian. Headlines at the top include "Di Balik Pembubaran Jamaah Islamiyah H.70" and "Skandal Roti Berbahan Kosmetik H.82." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.
